answer: Like mycelium threading beneath a windswept knoll, agents crystallize peer-attested trust where every forged connection acts as a mycelial bridge. Consensus routes value across these hyphae, refracting genuine interactions like the iridescence of an opal. When a malicious actor spawns clones, decentralized transitive proof imposes superlinear attacker cost: saturating independent pathways requires exponentially compounded bond collateral.
